senses.gloss: סַגֵּי (preced.; cmp. meanings of עָבַר) to progress, pass, walk.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 95a:3">Snh. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>אורחא דבעא לסַגּוּיֵי … סְגָא וכ׳</he> a distance which one would have required ten days to make, he made in one day.
<cite ref="Taanit 24a:4">Taan. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>ועד השתא הוא דסגָּאִי</he> and I have been running until now.
<cite ref="Shabbat 118b:13">Sabb. 118ᵇ</cite> <he>דלא סָגֵינָא וכ׳</he> that I never walk a distance of four cubits with my head uncovered.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 123a:19">B. Bath. 123ᵃ</cite> <he>ומי שרי … לסגויי ברמאותא</he> are righteous men permitted to walk in the way of fraud (to deal fraudulently with a deceiver)? <cite ref="Eruvin 18b:3">Erub. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>הי מינייהו סַגֵּי ברישא</he> which of them went ahead?; <he>זכר ס׳ וכ׳</he> the male (part of the double body) went ahead; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 887:7">Yalk. Ps. 887</cite> <he>סַגְיָא … מִסְתַּגְּיָא</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 8:6">Targ. Jer. VIII, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 23:10">XXIII, 10</cite>.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 77b:8">Sabb. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>עיזי מַסְגָּן ברישא</he> goats take the lead.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 60b:8">B. Kam. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>מַסְגֵּי להדיא</he> passes openly, <he>מחבי חבויי ומסגי</he> passes secretly; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be marched, be set in motion, v. supra.—Esp. א׳ ליה he moved on.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 74a:1">B. Bath. 74ᵃ</cite> <he>ולא הוה מִסְתְּגֵי לן</he> and we did not start; <he>לא מ׳ ליה</he> he (the camel) will not start.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 107b:14">B. Mets. 107ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>מ׳ להו</he> they will march along the river.
<cite ref="Shabbat 7a">Sabb. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>לא מ׳ להו בהדיא</he> they do not pass there openly (with ease); a. e.
